Five hard-learned lessons about AI evals
The team at Braintrust spends a lot of time deep in evaluation data, helping teams of all sizes ship reliable LLM‑powered products. We run the platform that powers those evals and observability workflows, so we see the successes and the failures up close. On an average day, our customers run ≈ 13 evals per org, and the most advanced teams push 3,000+ evals daily while spending hours poring over trace logs. All that usage has taught us five tough lessons.
